Wife Allegedly Kills Husband With Lover, Buries Body

Police in Gujarat's Jamnagar have uncovered a two-year-old murder case where a wife allegedly conspired with her former lover and his associate to kill her husband. The victim's body was reportedly buried in a 12-foot-deep pit at a factory. The wife had reportedly told the family that her husband had gone to Australia for work. The case came to light after a two-year disappearance investigation.
